description: This file defines the Time class within the PhpSpreadsheet library's Calculation component for handling Excel date/time functions, specifically implementing the TIME function and related time adjustments.

classes.name: Time
classes.description: Handles time-related calculations within PhpSpreadsheet, primarily implementing the Excel TIME function with support for array inputs and multiple return date formats.

methods.name: fromHMS
methods.description: Converts hour, minute, and second inputs into various date/time serial formats or PHP DateTime object based on configuration, incorporating time normalization and error handling.

methods.name: adjustSecond
methods.description: Normalizes second value and adjusts minutes if seconds are out of range.

methods.name: adjustMinute
methods.description: Normalizes minute value and adjusts hours if minutes are out of range.

methods.name: toIntWithNullBool
methods.description: Converts the input to an integer, handling booleans and nulls, and throws an exception if input is non-numeric.
